item.title: Tally to Binary: Understanding Data for Better Development
item.description:
Introduction

To write good software, you need a solid grip on data.

Every video you watch, every song you listen to, every message you read, they all feel different on the surface. But inside your device, they’re the same thing: binary, just 0s and 1s making everything come alive.
